mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_PLAN WHERE VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT TO_CHAR(days.day_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS day, COUNT(plan.PLAN_ID) AS value FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7 + LEVEL AS day_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) days LEFT JOIN TRAVEL_PLAN plan ON plan.CREATED_AT >= days.day_date AND plan.CREATED_AT < days.day_date + 1 GROUP BY days.day_date ORDER BY days.day_date

SELECT name, count FROM ( SELECT region.REGION_NAME AS name, COUNT(plan.PLAN_ID) AS count FROM TRAVEL_PLAN plan JOIN REGION_MASTER region ON region.REGION_CODE = plan.REGION_CODE WHERE plan.VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND plan.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY region.REGION_CODE, region.REGION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(plan.PLAN_ID) DESC, region.REGION_NAME ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
